We will provide you with a written validation of the debt, which will include the amount owed, the original creditor, and the charge-off date. We will also provide you with information regarding the last payment made on the account.

Please note that you have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe the validation is inaccurate. If you have any additional information or documentation to support your dispute, please provide it to us in writing.
